mapper.select: select ac.apt_cmplex_nm from mgmt_office mo join apt_complex ac on ac.apt_cmplex_no = mo.apt_cmplex_no where mo.mgmt_ofc_no = #{mgmtOfcNo}

select * from ( select row_number() over(order by p.reg_dt desc nulls last, p.partner_no desc) as rn , p.partner_no , p.apt_cmplex_no , ac.apt_cmplex_nm , p.biz_ty_nm , p.partner_nm , p.bizrno , p.use_yn , p.pic_nm , p.pic_telno , p.pic_email , to_char(p.reg_dt, 'yyyy/mm/dd') as reg_dt , to_char(p.mdf_dt, 'yyyy/mm/dd') as mdf_dt , ( select count(*) from facility_contract fc where fc.partner_no = p.partner_no ) as contract_cnt , ( select count(*) from facility_contract fc where fc.partner_no = p.partner_no and fc.cont_stts_cd = 'ACTIVE' ) as active_contract_cnt , ( select count(*) from facility_check_hstry fch where fch.partner_no = p.partner_no ) as check_cnt , ( select to_char(max(fch.chk_dt), 'yyyy/mm/dd') from facility_check_hstry fch where fch.partner_no = p.partner_no ) as recent_check_dt , ( select min(up.utility_provider_no) from utility_provider up where up.partner_no = p.partner_no ) as utility_provider_no , case when exists ( select 1 from utility_provider up where up.partner_no = p.partner_no ) then 'Y' else 'N' end as meter_linked_yn , ( select count(*) from utility_provider up join meter_hstry mh on mh.utility_provider_no = up.utility_provider_no where up.partner_no = p.partner_no ) as meter_cnt , ( select to_char(max(mh.meter_dt), 'yyyy/mm/dd') from utility_provider up join meter_hstry mh on mh.utility_provider_no = up.utility_provider_no where up.partner_no = p.partner_no ) as recent_meter_dt from partner p left join apt_complex ac on ac.apt_cmplex_no = p.apt_cmplex_no
) partner_list where rn between #{startRow} and #{endRow}

select count(*) as total_cnt , nvl(sum(case when p.use_yn = 'Y' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as active_cnt , nvl(sum(case when exists ( select 1 from facility_contract fc where fc.partner_no = p.partner_no ) then 1 else 0 end), 0) as contract_linked_cnt , nvl(sum(case when exists ( select 1 from utility_provider up where up.partner_no = p.partner_no ) then 1 else 0 end), 0) as meter_linked_cnt from partner p where p.apt_cmplex_no = #{aptCmplexNo}
select distinct p.biz_ty_nm from partner p where p.apt_cmplex_no = #{aptCmplexNo} and p.biz_ty_nm is not null order by p.biz_ty_nm
